meta.title: 你绝对没注意过自己日常生活中的表情，原来
meta.title_en: You've Never Noticed Your Everyday Expressions
meta.topic: 形体训练 · 眼神定力与表情管理

scenes.context: 普通人走路时眼睛到处看、嘴巴无意识张开，缺乏眼神与表情管理。
sentences: 走路的时候你眼睛是这样子的。
That's how your eyes look when you walk.
paraphrase: Unconscious little expressions you don't notice.
It quietly chips away at your presence.
scenes.speak: That's how your eyes look when you walk. Why are you glancing around? The first is gaze focus.

scenes.context: 闭眼后睁眼十秒不眨眼，酸感说明眼睛在用力；走路时一个地方看三秒再换。
sentences: 酸的时候你的眼睛就在用力。
When it stings, your eyes are working.
Hold your gaze on one spot for three seconds.
paraphrase: Find that focused, engaged feeling in your eyes.
Switch your viewpoint every three seconds.
scenes.speak: Don't blink for ten seconds. When it stings, your eyes are working. Hold your gaze on one spot for three seconds.

scenes.context: 面无表情是克制无意识表情的结果，配合肩开腹收颈立背挺的行走姿态。
sentences: 你就面无表情就可以了。
keep it blank（保持面无表情）
Keeping a blank face is actually hard.
paraphrase: Reining in the tiny unconscious movements.
A poised, confident way of walking.
scenes.speak: Don't purse your lips. Just keep your face blank. Keeping a blank face is actually hard.

scenes.context: 看镜头三秒、看前面三秒，眼神坚定，气质立现。
sentences: Look at the camera for three seconds.
学过的小孩就是不一样。
scenes.speak: Look at the camera for three seconds. The gaze is steady now. Trained students are just different.

practice: 走路时眼睛应该怎么看？
Hold each viewpoint for three seconds instead of darting around.
十秒不眨眼练习中眼睛酸说明什么？
It means your eyes are working and you've found the engaged feeling.
Because you must suppress many unconscious micro-expressions.
气质行走的四句口令是什么？
Shoulders open, stomach in, neck tall, back straight.
pitfalls: Use the 10-second drill as practice, then blink naturally.
Forcing dryness ruins your eyes; training builds control.
Keep it calm and controlled, not frozen.
A blank face is reined-in, not rigid.
Pair gaze control with walking posture.
Poise comes from the whole body, not just the eyes.
Repeat the drills in daily life.
